name: Canaria-Systems-S3-constrained-memory-feasibility-v1

calibration_source.note: S2 is calibration only; S3 outcomes are newly generated under an explicit memory ceiling

source_payload.description: G7 seed-4300 learned Canaria compiler block chunks generated in S2

memory_limit.warmup_before_limit: load/touch one learned block, release, gc, start RSS sampler, then record current VMS
memory_limit.rule: limit = post-warmup baseline VMS + 64 MiB; do not change after outcomes

pass_rule.full_unconstrained_control: must complete all 4096 chunks and match expected checksum
pass_rule.streaming_constrained: must complete all 4096 chunks and match expected checksum under unchanged limit
pass_rule.full_constrained: must fail from allocation/address-space exhaustion before retaining all 4096 chunks
pass_rule.failure_validation: arbitrary crashes or unrelated errors do not count as expected memory failure

interpretation_boundary: Constrained Linux process feasibility test for a learned payload harness only. Not a specific MCU/mobile/SBC deployment and not scientific composition evidence.
